+Today the run event observer sends child events only to `RunCallJoinTable` ("no join"), and the client sees one `agents` tool call. +Approach: reuse `ACPEventTranslator` (`Sources/FoundationModelsACPAgent/Agent/ACPEventTranslator.swift`). +Keep the shell output rule: the terminal stream still needs the entry for a child shell run (`RunCallJoinTable.recordAgentRunEvent`). Change it so the entry holds the child tool call id, not "no join". Update the comments of `RunCallJoinTable` that say "The agent run sends no wire update of its tool runs".

+

+- [ ] Update `Tests/FoundationModelsACPAgentTests` tests of `RunCallJoinTable` for the new entry.

+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #subagents
